summary: APM on c058_nic is discarding 0.78% of packets (56,040 drops on APM eth1) because capture interface cannot keep up; link is healthy but tool is oversubscribed.

findings.root_cause: APM eth1 is oversubscribed - the tool's capture interface/kernel cannot keep up with the delivered rate and is discarding packets (0.78% loss vs 0.001 threshold). check_link_errors is healthy, so this is not a physical link error but a capacity/delivery-rate issue at the tool.
findings.impact_on_tool: APM loses ~0.78% of packets/flows, causing incomplete transaction reconstruction, inaccurate latency and error-rate metrics, and missed application performance detections.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across multiple APM capture ports/instances via packet broker load-balancing to bring per-interface rate within the 10G APM's sustainable capture capacity. Since APM needs_full_payload=false, broker-side slicing or filtering to reduce volume is also viable if load-balancing is not possible.
